answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 22 identities per epoch. Audits are entered in willow, queued in sonnet, and spiral publishes the wait time. A farm of 365 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 1892 identities would post 3242 proofs and burn roughly 62 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
